Clinical interpretation: Age of female partner at initiation of treatment cycle (years).
Potential availability at prediction tim: Available at all prediction timepoints.
Reason for decision: Primary known biological determinant of oocyte quality and aneuploidy risk; available pre-stimulation.
Unresolved documentation requirements: None; standard demographic variable in years (range: 20-49).

Clinical interpretation: Historical count of previous or current assisted reproductive treatment attempts.
Potential availability at prediction tim: Available at all prediction timepoints.
Reason for decision: Clinical prognostic marker of past cycle failure or success; available at baseline.
Unresolved documentation requirements: Author clarification needed on whether '1' denotes first cycle (0 prior) or 1 prior failed cycle. Typographical artifact '`1' must be sanitized to 1.

Clinical interpretation: Anti-Müllerian Hormone; endocrine biomarker of ovarian functional reserve.
Potential availability at prediction tim: Available at all prediction timepoints.
Reason for decision: Standard clinical biomarker reflecting follicular pool and stimulation responsiveness.
Unresolved documentation requirements: Measurement unit and assay method require author confirmation (typical ng/mL vs pmol/L; extreme values up to 482.1 require clinical contextualization).

Clinical interpretation: Nominal identifier representing clinical ovarian stimulation regimen and medication protocol.
Potential availability at prediction tim: Presumed available pre-stimulation IF representing planned protocol; UNCERTAIN if recording actual administered medications, adjustments, or trigger protocol.
Reason for decision: Clinical protocol prescribes stimulation strategy, but actual administered medications/adjustments occur throughout stimulation. Included conditionally in Scenario A only under the assumption of planned protocol; if author confirms it reflects post-stimulation administered treatment, it must be deferred to Scenario B.
Unresolved documentation requirements: High-priority author clarification needed: Does this code record the initial planned protocol prescribed before stimulation, or actual medications/doses administered throughout the cycle? Missing mapping dictionary for the 182 integer codes (1-183).

Clinical interpretation: Calendar timestamp when oocyte pick-up (OPU) aspiration procedure was performed.
Potential availability at prediction tim: Available post-retrieval; procedure schedule known shortly before.
Reason for decision: Procedure date should not be a direct predictor to prevent overfitting to calendar artifacts. Reserved for prospective chronological train/test splitting.
Unresolved documentation requirements: Time-of-day information not recorded; date format spans 2019-01-02 to 2025-06-30 across 1,400 distinct dates.

Clinical interpretation: Count of Metaphase II oocytes (extruded first polar body; nuclear mature and fertilizable).
Potential availability at prediction tim: Available post-retrieval on Day 0.
Reason for decision: Only observable after oocyte denudation and laboratory microscopic grading; unavailable prior to stimulation.
Unresolved documentation requirements: Confirmation needed whether denudation was performed for ICSI alone or also for conventional IVF cycles.

Clinical interpretation: Count of Metaphase I oocytes (intermediate nuclear maturity, no polar body, no germinal vesicle).
Potential availability at prediction tim: Available post-retrieval on Day 0.
Reason for decision: Laboratory embryology finding post-retrieval; represents cycle cohort maturation efficiency.
Unresolved documentation requirements: None; integer count (range: 0-32).

Clinical interpretation: Count of other retrieved oocytes (germinal vesicle [GV], atretic, degenerated, or fractured zona).
Potential availability at prediction tim: Available post-retrieval on Day 0.
Reason for decision: Laboratory post-retrieval metric reflecting oocyte dysmaturity or degeneration.
Unresolved documentation requirements: Author clarification needed on the proportion of GV vs degenerated oocytes grouped in this category.

Clinical interpretation: Age of male partner / sperm provider at treatment cycle (years).
Potential availability at prediction tim: Available at all prediction timepoints.
Reason for decision: Biological factor influencing sperm DNA fragmentation, blastocyst formation, and paternal contribution.
Unresolved documentation requirements: None; integer demographic variable (range: 19-57).

Clinical interpretation: Sperm concentration from diagnostic / semen analysis.
Potential availability at prediction tim: Presumed available pre-stimulation IF diagnostic baseline; UNCERTAIN if retrieval-day post-wash sample.
Reason for decision: Standard male factor evaluation occurs at baseline, but semen is also collected and processed on oocyte retrieval day. Included conditionally in Scenario A under diagnostic assumption; if retrieval-day sample, belongs in Scenario B.
Unresolved documentation requirements: High-priority author clarification needed: Does this represent pre-cycle diagnostic semen analysis or retrieval-day fresh sample? Units assumed million/mL.

Clinical interpretation: Percentage of motile spermatozoa in semen sample (%).
Potential availability at prediction tim: Presumed available pre-stimulation IF diagnostic baseline; UNCERTAIN if retrieval-day post-wash sample.
Reason for decision: Functional sperm parameter reflecting sample vitality. Included conditionally in Scenario A under diagnostic assumption; if measured on retrieval day, belongs in Scenario B.
Unresolved documentation requirements: High-priority author clarification needed: Diagnostic baseline vs retrieval day; total motility (PR + NP) vs progressive motility (PR) alone.

Clinical interpretation: Normal sperm morphology assessment score or percentage.
Potential availability at prediction tim: Presumed available pre-stimulation IF diagnostic baseline; UNCERTAIN if retrieval-day sample.
Reason for decision: Standard diagnostic morphological indicator of teratozoospermia. Included conditionally in Scenario A under diagnostic assumption; if retrieval day, belongs in Scenario B.
Unresolved documentation requirements: High-priority author clarification needed: Diagnostic baseline vs retrieval day; values strictly range 0.0 to 3.0 (strict Kruger % vs ordinal 0-3 grading scale).

Clinical interpretation: Count of normally fertilized oocytes displaying two pronuclei (2PN) 16-18 hours post-insemination.
Potential availability at prediction tim: Available on Day 1 post-retrieval.
Reason for decision: First developmental milestone indicating fertilization success; unavailable prior to retrieval.
Unresolved documentation requirements: Confirmation whether 1PN or multipronuclear (>=3PN) abnormal zygotes are excluded (standard 2PN assumed).

Clinical interpretation: Count of high-quality (Grade 1) embryos during developmental culture.
Potential availability at prediction tim: Available on Day 3 or Day 5 post-retrieval.
Reason for decision: Reflects cleavage / blastocyst morphological top quality; unavailable at baseline or Day 1.
Unresolved documentation requirements: Exact laboratory morphological scoring system (Gardner vs Veeck / Istanbul consensus cleavage criteria) requires author documentation.

Clinical interpretation: Count of fair-quality (Grade 2) embryos during developmental culture.
Potential availability at prediction tim: Available on Day 3 or Day 5 post-retrieval.
Reason for decision: Embryology culture morphological metric; unavailable earlier.
Unresolved documentation requirements: Laboratory scoring tier definitions require documentation.

Clinical interpretation: Count of poor-quality (Grade 3) embryos during developmental culture.
Potential availability at prediction tim: Available on Day 3 or Day 5 post-retrieval.
Reason for decision: Embryology culture morphological metric; unavailable earlier.
Unresolved documentation requirements: Laboratory scoring tier definitions require documentation.

Clinical interpretation: Count of severely fragmented / arrested (Grade 4) embryos.
Potential availability at prediction tim: Available on Day 3 or Day 5 post-retrieval.
Reason for decision: Embryology culture morphological metric; unavailable earlier.
Unresolved documentation requirements: Laboratory scoring tier definitions require documentation.

Clinical interpretation: Total count of viable cleaved embryos / blastocysts obtained in the cycle.
Potential availability at prediction tim: Available on day of planned embryo transfer.
Reason for decision: Summary measure of embryonic yield available immediately prior to transfer decision.
Unresolved documentation requirements: Relationship with sum of individual grades requires documentation (in 1,250 cases with non-return, value is 0).

Clinical interpretation: Count of surplus or electively cryopreserved (vitrified) embryos.
Potential availability at prediction tim: Decided concurrently with fresh embryo transfer or freeze-all strategy.
Reason for decision: Embryology disposition decision reflecting overall surplus embryo cohort quality.
Unresolved documentation requirements: Spelling in source is 'frezzing'; author clarification needed whether vitrification occurred on Day 3, Day 5, or both.

Clinical interpretation: Serum beta-human chorionic gonadotropin measured 10-14 days post-embryo transfer.
Potential availability at prediction tim: Unavailable at any pre-transfer prediction timepoint.
Reason for decision: Measured weeks after embryo transfer; represents direct biological target leakage. Including it invalidates prospective clinical prediction.
Unresolved documentation requirements: Qualitative strings ('Non-return of embryos', 'NEGATIVE', 'POSITIVE') and numeric titers are blended; contains 8 discordant records relative to outcome.

Clinical interpretation: Recorded binary cycle outcome in dataset (0 = negative outcome / no viable implantation, 1 = positive outcome). Critical clinical note: Class 0 combines cycles without embryo transfer (1,250 records with 'Non-return of embryos'), completed transfers with negative pregnancy tests (1,250 records with 'NEGATIVE'), and 8 positive β-HCG cases with non-progressing implantation. Must NOT be referred to uniformly as 'implantation failure' because implantation was impossible in cycles lacking embryo transfer.
Potential availability at prediction tim: Dependent variable / Ground truth target.
Reason for decision: Ground truth binary label for predictive models. Retains original binary values (0/1) but designated as 'recorded_cycle_outcome' until dataset authors confirm the exact clinical definition (biochemical vs clinical pregnancy vs ongoing pregnancy).
Unresolved documentation requirements: High-priority author clarification needed: What is the exact clinical definition of outcome 1? Does it represent biochemical pregnancy, ultrasound gestational sac at 5-7 weeks, fetal heartbeat, or live birth? Why are non-transferred cycles (Non-return of embryos) grouped together with post-transfer negative tests in Class 0?
